notes.title: September 18th, 2025 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Sound the trumpets, bang the drums, hang the party banners and get on your finest attire, for a mid-season Balance Patch is upon us! Let’s dig right into these delectable morsels and see what all the changes this patch has to offer.
[hr][/hr]Card Changes[p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560184/322d8a00c1e2ed41ec5aa2b1ed1e61e2596fee54.png"]
Hannibal[p align="start"]Since Hannibal was introduced at the beginning of the month on the premium Galaxy Pass, he has outperformed our expectations and the results of every other captain. We are tweaking his countdown from 6 animals KO’d to 7 in an effort to bring him better into parity with our other captains. Not a major change so we expect him to still be a strong captain, but will no longer be so far ahead.
[hr][/hr]Card Reworks
Loki

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560184/0dae4c187858c6ad0a2de71a44c148296bbc13ea.png"]
[p align="start"]This is partly a quality of life upgrade, your spells will do more of what you expect. And a pretty big power up, so we will keep an eye on how he performs.
[hr][/hr]
Mirror Mirror

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560184/b0fcd8f2194eeeecc4fc8be553e58e57ce852b0c.png"]
[hr][/hr]Major Changes
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560184/59c0b3f5f846cb4851802a88230367cf38c76349.png"]

Parting Gift now only doubles farewells in your front row. (We expect this to still be one of the strongest Epic treasures)

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560184/c00adf9ea72de8dd22e432edf06ee0dfa14b7273.png"]

Shrink Tea now targets the enemy with the highest attack. We considered renaming it to “Herc B-Gone!” but leaving it as Shrink Tea for now.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560184/785051065ca144f16465257a8609a19ec7aedbec.png"]

Weird Beard has been reverted back to only giving treasures based on Goldened Pirates instead of Silver. (Was in just too many of the top performing decklists)

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560184/cbb47aef478407647a9115c712dd6e2b06b11d76.png"]

Morgan Le Fae getting a bit of a power up, should be impactful with spell themes prevalent with Candylar (our first expansion coming in October)

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560184/9b620c4586e5163e7e183955ae499da6bc281cb2.png"]

Shanty getting a pretty meaningful powerup. We didn’t want her to have to combine with Wink or the Pans to make an impact.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560184/97ea70ba52b7aeb2d8dddbcbf56e151843b0c0bf.png"]

Dragon Dice getting a nerf should leave it in a strong spot for increasing Treasure Hoard while not giving the late game powerful common treasures, as often. It also means Dragon Dice treasures will not eat Lesser Mimic copies which was a common downside before.
[hr][/hr]Minor Changes
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560184/1df6e7e5e9a55f781e0950eee1b6f053aa1cdb10.png"]

Jack Sparrow has been renamed to Jay Sparrow

Excalibur and KO Star now keep buff during fight (mostly a bug fix)

Happily Ever After and All for One will now wait until the next shop before Buffing (this change in timing doesn’t change how the cards functioned before but does make it clearer the buff is being applied)

Zagreus now waits until the next shop to determine the rarity of treasure given and now works with Smug
[hr][/hr]Bug Fixes
Charon’s upgrading buff not working correctly on a non-full board has been fixed

Mid-Battle “start turn” button has been fixed

Leaderboard and navbar should no longer overlap
[hr][/hr]Quality of Life Change[p align="start"]Buffs like the hunt abilities of Hercules and Big Bad Wolf will now trigger before effects like Poison Apple. The result of this change should be that Herc and Big Bad Wolf end up at 1 health rather than them being set to 1 hp and then buffing up again. We are making this change in order to allow effects like Poison Apple to be better counters to large stated lads.
[hr][/hr]Candylar: The Sweet Set - Meet the New Captain
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560184/81b4d4317f329915a5583f5788bf0b5943f547c2.png"]
[p align="start"]Coming to a Galaxy near you this October!
[hr][/hr][p align="start"]Well that is a lot of changes! Come sound off in the Discord and the Subreddit to let us know what you think of these changes and also stay tuned to our Twitter, Bluesky and Instagram and your favorite Once Upon a Galaxy content creators for Candylar spoilers over the next several weeks!
[p align="start"]‘Til next time, see you in the stars.

notes.title: Patch Notes: August 28th, 2025
notes.content:
In-Game Store[p align="start"]With September rolling in, we’ve got to say goodbye to some amazing skins in the store. Leonardo di Skippi, Wicked Vengeance Hades and Princess Miyazaki will be leaving the In-Game Store on September 1st. Pick them up before they leave!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560184/04546b4a68ea552f639f9701f45ccd4903569d30.png"]
[p align="start"]Maximus harnesses the power of the cosmos in this amazing new ‘Lightning Tiger Hoo’ skin!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560184/914b27662902feb2cec37f116121d80844541da3.png"]
[p align="start"]Some fan favorite skins are making their return to the shop this month, ‘You Shall Not Pass’ and ‘Big Bad Piggie’ !

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560184/b9902c00f3b62ccdb92d63500a0828938bcd4f1f.png"]
[hr][/hr]Bug Fixes and Other Changes


Improved optimization to allow for complex late-game scenarios better and abort complex battles less often.

In Async mode, when the game abandons a complex fight mid-combat (like when you have a lot of hunt triggers), we now count it as a battle win for the active player. This will allow games to reach a conclusion.

When viewing the locked Galaxy Pass captain during Captain Select, you can now see and zoom in on the Captain to read their abilities.

Type Tags now show in shop while playing Chief Evil Officer (Villains), King Arthur (Heroes), Boy Who Cried Werewolf (Animal) and Hannibal (Animal).

Type tags will be hidden during battle and fix visual bugs when switching between multiple tags each action during shop phase.


Jack Sparrow Bug Fix[p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560184/bd7c7e19482b63730ada79a900d5093414bd26c4.png"]
[p align="start"]We are also fixing an inconsistency we found with Jack Sparrow where it would sometimes be +1 additional hunt trigger and other times it would be 2x hunt triggers.
[p align="start"]Generally, we lean towards +1 additional trigger when we use the term “Double” and this is how Hunter’s Horn works. We have fixed these inconsistencies by making Jack always be +1 additional hunt trigger.


[hr][/hr]Candylar: The Sweet Set
Here is a little bonus sneak peak of the first Galaxy expansion filled with tons of new cards and fun.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560184/93d08141cf72141b3b7e9e743017161523632265.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560184/70b8c95a7bc09944ecd1959330b78e3b37b5ca4d.png"]



Candylar: The Sweet Set drops on all platforms in October!


[hr][/hr][p align="start"]That's all for now! May your Animals be plentiful, may your pool parties rock and may your bottle be ever full of Pumpkin Spice Latte.
[p align="start"]Come let us know what you think of the patch changes in the Discord, on Twitter, Bluesky, Reddit and Instagram or come join our weekly Dev Twitch Streams on Tuesdays at 2pm EST.
[p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560184/69a4cfe9ef048ddca32d471c5ecb9e1066c8bb4b.png"]
[p align="start"]We would also love to hear your thoughts in a review on Steam, Android and in the Apple App Store. Leaving those reviews is a huge help to an indie company like ours and helps us make our millions of dreams come true.

notes.title: Patch Notes: August 18th, 2025
notes.content:
[p align="start"]What an insane first half of August for Once Upon a Galaxy. Thousands of new players flooding in every week and y’alls reviews, comments, support and all the streams and content have been truly loved by our small team. With the fire fully stoked beneath us, we are scorching through the summer with some big big updates to come soon. For now, we’ve got some balance changes, new music and an elephant enters the room. Let’s dig in.
[hr][/hr]Music

[p align="start"]With the Steam release, we have gotten a ton of feedback about the lack of music in the client. We have a lot of grand plans and ideas for Music and SFX that will take time to get fully commissioned and implemented.
[p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560184/91609b281e73d64ac99db48d5da6829267946004.png"]
[p align="start"]For now, we have licensed some wonderful placeholder music from Fesliyan Studios who made the main screen music you may have heard already.
[hr][/hr]Card Changes

[p align="start"]Overall, we are really happy with our overall balance. That said, there are always a few outliers on both ends and we are looking to bring some of those back into line.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560184/5631d9057c4d11efa12946ec9c2091fb0bd025e7.png"]
Major Changes
Wind Up Toy now gains +2 attack when attacked (was +1)

Mortakon’s Quest now needs to see 50 total stats summoned (was 30)

Tsarmina now buffs +4/+4 when it’s supported hunts (was +3/+3) ; Also now requires only 4 hunts for her quest (was 6)

Dragonmother no longer gives +5 attack on transform

Pisces now increases fae buffs by +3/+3 (was +2/+2)

Flying Monkey is now a 2/2 (was a 3/2)

Ninja-in-Training is no longer a Toy (was a Toy Animal Hero, now Animal Hero)

Combustible Dragon now has Treasure Hoard 3 (was 2)

Buried Treasure now gives Treasure Hoard 2 (was 3)

Pirate Prince now gives 1 random common treasure (was 2)

Weird Beard and Tiamat’s Claw can no longer give Secret Rare treasures (unless your captain is Artemis
Minor Changes
Earth Stone triggers at start of turn, not start of battle (text already reflected this but now the effect matches)

Sinbad now triggers on Midas Touch (was always the intention but it now works)

Greed and Dragon’s Crown now have helper text.

Fixed Ace of Hearts Golden text to reflect actual effect (it gives 2 bonus shops not 1)
[hr][/hr]Quality of Life Changes, Bug Fixes, Various Improvements


Added a “down for maintenance” mode to limit impact of future outages

Opponents' boards will no longer disappear after you lose a fight (this was a bug)

Melody’s Lute no longer triggers itself (also a bug)

Zeus now shows multiplier and highlights on spells when active

Added Music and Sound volume sliders

Fixed a bug where you’d get a blank screen while reconnecting during Captain Select of a Live Lobby

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560184/1f7f127121f12168614dadaa85f65473a9d59195.png"]


[hr][/hr]Please Review Us![p align="start"]The Steam launch has been an absolute resounding success for Once Upon a Galaxy so far. For those of you who have already left a review, it has made all the difference as it tells Steam that people love our game and encourages them to show us to new players.
[p align="start"]Those who have not gotten around to reviewing us, please do so on all platforms you consume our game on. It goes a long way to keeping our momentum going.
[hr][/hr][p align="start"]Come let us know what you think of the patch changes in the Discord, on Twitter, Bluesky, Reddit and Instagram or come join our weekly Dev Twitch Streams on Tuesdays at 2pm EST and be sure to leave us a review on Steam, Android and in the Apple App Store!

notes.title: Once Upon a Galaxy is out now!
notes.content:
Welcome to your journey into our Galaxy! 
First-time visitor? New captains are always welcome! Feel free to dive right in, and you can find info \[in the guidebook](https://galaxy.fun/learn/) to help get started.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560184/88e98542a599451e72b701f1835daa983b79e0cd.png"]
The moment is upon us and we need YOUR help!
We’d really appreciate your help leaving a review and spreading the word! Whether you’ve been with us since the beginning of the closed beta or you’ve just discovered us, we couldn’t be more excited to have such an amazing group of players providing feedback and helping us make Once Upon a Galaxy the best game it can be!

If you’re enjoying your time in our little Galaxy, leaving a Steam review is one of the most powerful ways you can help our small team. Reviews don’t just boost visibility — they help new players discover the game, shape our future development, and keep this galaxy expanding.

We read every single one, and your words mean more than you know. Thank You!


[hr][/hr]

Adventures are always better with friends
You're welcome to join our wonderful Discord community! You can also find us on Twitter, Bluesky, Reddit and Instagram, and we have weekly Dev Twitch Streams on Tuesdays at 2pm EST!


[hr][/hr]

Boy Who Cried Werewolf, Gencon and More...
This Steam release comes with game updates and other news. Information on the coming Galaxy Pass with an exciting new Captain, GenCon and more are all in the patch notes!

notes.title: Patch Notes: July 29th, 2025
notes.content:
August is here and with it, one of the most pivotal moments in the life of Once Upon a Galaxy. We are officially live on Steam! More information on that, the coming Galaxy Pass with an exciting new Captain, GenCon and more are all in these patch notes so let’s dive in!
[hr][/hr]The moment is upon us and we need YOUR help!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560184/88e98542a599451e72b701f1835daa983b79e0cd.png"]

Once Upon a Galaxy is now available on Steam and we’d really appreciate your help leaving a review and spreading the word!

Find the full announcement here, thank You!
[hr][/hr]Galaxy PassPremium Galaxy Pass
Part shepherd, part troublemaker, and 100% werewolf, this wild child is ready to shake up the galaxy!



Boy who Cried Werewolf

Recruit 3 Animals and double the Attack and Health of the next character you recruit, turning it into an animal.



Come play with him and unleash your inner beast!

Available August 1st on the Premium Galaxy Pass.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560184/da2b4be9a3570ecf5ed27362da018226022d3f61.png"]

Doctor, doctor give me the news, I got a bad case of loving this amazing new Dr Agon MD skin. Unlock Dr. Agon MD at level 30 of the August Premium Galaxy Pass.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560184/efba0b92bc098a4d8027862c222839fa56b2bd1e.png"]

Nothing puts a young werewolf pup to sleep like one last game of Galaxy. Come tuck this little good boy to sleep by unlocking the Bedtime for Barky skin at level 50 of the August Premium Galaxy Pass.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560184/14e60c7827a6da03b6abdb5c75a95b9cac081695.png"]
Free Pass
Silversmith joins the Free Galaxy Pass this August. Recruit those silvered characters and gain fantastic rewards!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560184/2b966033f61ed8f43e30899e4fd7163b29739145.png"]

This fish has no fear, King Midas leads his golden animatronic army in their quest for Galactic revenge. Unlock Fishbowl Midas at level 40 of the Free Galaxy Pass in August.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560184/7c6c84298fb3a7904ccac8de75452191e90a9f3c.png"]
[hr][/hr]Quality of Life Changes, Bug Fixes, Various Gameplay Tweaks
Banking is only enabled after all 5 character slots have been filled

Tapping/Clicking on the Bank will now bring up a tooltip

New Code Redemption

We’ve implemented a new way to redeem codes in the app for various rewards! Check out your favorite streamers and content creators soon as we will be handing out codes for folks to collect in-game rewards!

Card zoom now pauses combat again as intended

Reroll and Settings buttons have been updated

Completely new Tutorial and New Player onboarding experience

App not saving Sound/Music Settings has been fixed

Sort order for Captain select is now starter deck, bonus decks and then user decks

User’s custom decks will now have no deck art (this is intentional for now)

Shop buffs now pause for animation again and won’t overlap with the combat lobby

Better layouts for users on 16:10 resolutions or similar

Behind the scenes tweaks to prevent some MacOS crashes
[hr][/hr]Gencon 2025
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560184/448f49d67c52d556f170dd620fcb12b66ae1c8d8.png"]

We’re heading to GenCon2025 and we’re bringing the galaxy with us! ✨

Join the Once Upon a Galaxy crew live in Indianapolis, July 31 – August 3, for a weekend full of exclusive giveaways, live demos, developer meetups, and cosmic surprises.

Whether you’re a seasoned space pirate or just picking up your first Captain, we’d love to meet you. Come say hi, play a few rounds, and snag some goodies you won’t find anywhere else!

We will be located between the Event Hall and the Exhibition Hall that has all the booths.
[hr][/hr]
The stars are shining brightly upon Once Upon a Galaxy and we are excited to share this journey with all of you!

Come let us know what you think of the patch changes in the Discord, on Twitter, Bluesky, Reddit and Instagram or come join our weekly Dev Twitch Streams on Tuesdays at 2pm EST and be sure to leave us a review on Steam, Android and in the Apple App Store!
